about: The golden files of the engine for a port (docs/world.md, 'For a port'). Each world file is a log of events; folding it gives a city whose text, as 'python3 -m bibliopolis world fold' writes it, has the sha256 below. tests/test_world_examples.py keeps these files, this index and the engine equal.

worlds.what: every kind of event but a merge: roads opened from the middle of the ring road, houses filed out of roads and out of the ring road, a road with roads below it moved, a rename, a rule, an undo from the middle; items with no topic

OpenAlex topics: a suggestion taken as it stands, roads that stand for nodes, a house with topics in two domains, the rule auto splitting a road three levels down in one event, a move of a road for a node, an undo

the first ring filled (13 avenues) and merged: a merge by suggestion and one by hand, avenues in the freed directions, an avenue moved below another road (its direction is free for the next), a rename, a filing, an undo

the branches: a ring of five that the rule auto merges by itself when a domain needs an avenue (a merge and a split in one event), the ring road renamed, a merge below a road, the branches raised and lowered and a larger max (the whole world laid out again), an undo
